A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]''' who survived the initial [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi Purge]] and was proficient in [[Form VI/Legends|Jar'kai]]. At sometime during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], they battled for their life against [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] with their two blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].
